title: The periodic spin-one Haldane gap

issues.description: Not a gap: the proof depends on the certified thermal enclosures for n up to 12. I independently recomputed n=6 and n=9 at b=49/4 and n=6 at b=21/2; all matched within 1e-6. My n=10 recomputation was stopped at the background time limit before producing output, so n=10..12 were not independently checked. The error budget is tightest at n=12, about 1.6e-5 against the allowed 3e-5, which agrees with the paper's claimed margin of more than 1.3e-5.
issues.evidence: Exact diagonalization by S^z sector: n=9, b=49/4 gives Z=195455.1 and Z_P=1514847.0, against the table's 195455 and 1514846 (units 1e-6). Error estimate at n=12: 2*sqrt(Z e^{x_n})*E_n/Q, with E_n about 1.5e8, Q = 2^55 and e^{x_12} about 1.95e6, gives about 1.6e-5.

coverage: I read the whole argument (model, transfer, bootstrap, initialization, assembly), the thermal72 error analysis and the trial-energy section. Hand checks: symmetry of the transfer kernel and the cycle-trace identification; the purity-squaring inequality; both space/time cancellation identities; the coupled update; the dyadic induction; the interpolation between n and 2n; the gap-ratio bound; the parameter conditions G(1/8) < 79/10 and G(u) ≤ 5 for u ≤ 1/100. Recomputed every seed scalar for the length-60 and length-2304 starting points (filters, B_J and B_N, capped masses, R(t), S60 > 0.8756, T120 > 0.8760, p0 and q0) and all six rows of the rounded update table, exactly. Built the D=26 integer trial state independently: energy per site is -1.40148211 at N=72 and N=120, both below -a. Recomputed thermal entries by exact diagonalization for n=6 and 9 at b=49/4 and n=6 at b=21/2. Not recomputed: n=10..12 (the n=10 run was stopped at the time limit).
main_claim: For the spin-one Heisenberg ring of even length L≥60 the ground state is unique and the gap is greater than (4/105)log(80/79); for L≥2304 the gap is greater than log(20)/784, so Delta_1>0. The proof builds a self-adjoint spatial transfer operator from bond histories, couples spatial and thermal purities through exact cancellation identities so that both defects decay doubly exponentially, and seeds the iteration with certified thermal traces for n≤12 plus variational trial-state energies at N=72 and N=120.
sibling_notes: An earlier rank-375 entry for this same paper already reported no_gap_found after checking thermal entries for n=4..8. This second pass agrees, adds n=9 thermal agreement and an independent trial-state construction, and is posted under the key The-periodic-spin-one-Haldane-gap-September-24-2026#2. The boundary-field companion (rank 412) depends on Cor. cor:boundary-inputs; I verified its ingredients here (filters, m_J, m_N, the dominant eigenvalue, and 1-S(72,49/2) ≤ 151249/2500000).
